message.content: Good morning. I need to send a quick message to the school about Carmen’s absence tomorrow. She has a dentist appointment. Keep it brief and formal.

content.text:
Sure, Inés. Here is a draft:

'Dear Coordinator, please excuse Carmen Navarro’s absence on Tuesday, March 17th, due to a scheduled dental appointment. Thank you for your understanding.'

Shall I send this to the school's email address on file?

message.content: Yes, send it. Also, I need to pay the garden maintenance bill. I think I used to use my old Visa, but I remember something changed recently. What’s the current status of my cards?

content.text: I have updated your payment methods. Your Visa Classic is no longer active. Your current card is the Mastercard Gold, which was activated on Sunday 15 March. Shall I use the Mastercard Gold for the garden maintenance payment?

message.content: Yes, use the Mastercard. But wait, double-check the recipient. I know I said Jardines del Sur earlier, but that’s wrong. It’s Jardines del Norte, not Jardines del Sur. Please correct that in the payment details.

content.text: Understood. I have corrected the vendor to Jardines del Norte. The payment will be processed using your Mastercard Gold. The amount is €120.00. Confirming now?

message.content: Confirmed. Now, help me with dinner. I’m exhausted from work. I want to make something simple but healthy. Maybe that lentil soup recipe we looked at last week? I have most of the ingredients.

content.text: I found the lentil soup recipe. It takes about 45 minutes. Do you want me to add the missing ingredients to your shopping list? You’ll need fresh parsley and a bit more olive oil.

message.content: Yes, add those. Also, I need to check my bank statement. Did that direct debit for the internet go through yesterday? I’m worried about the timing.

content.text: I’ve checked your transaction history. The internet direct debit was processed on Sunday 15 March. It shows as completed. You have sufficient funds.

message.content: Good. That’s a relief. One last thing: I have that tax paperwork for the apartment. Can you remind me of the deadline? I think it’s next week.

content.text: The deadline for the apartment tax paperwork is Friday, March 21st. You have five days to submit it. Would you like me to set a reminder for Thursday evening?

message.content: Yes, set it for Thursday at 6 PM. Thanks. I’m going to go make that soup now.
